content.title: Prop Recovery | External Loss, Consolation, Motivated Hidden Retrieval
content.summary: Show two characters jointly using one desirable prop before a third party removes it. Give the pair different reactions and one consolation beat, then retrieve an equivalent functional prop from a previously plausible hidden location and restore the original joint activity.

quick_start.input_format: two characters jointly use one prop + visible third-party removal + asymmetric reactions + one consolation gesture + motivated hidden retrieval by the partner + restored joint activity
quick_start.recommended_input: Two adult-coded lunar survey robots jointly study one translucent route slate at a navigation table until an adult mission supervisor removes it. The compact cobalt robot flashes one amber error pulse and steadies its sand-colored partner; the partner opens a chest compartment visible from the first shot, retrieves a backup slate, and both resume route planning with one synchronized confirmation.
required_anchors: Show two characters jointly using one desirable prop before it is removed.
Use one visible third-party action to remove the prop and stop the shared activity.
Recover an equivalent functional prop from a previously plausible hidden location controlled by the partner.
Return both characters to the original joint activity and hold the restored relationship.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Show two characters jointly using one desirable prop before a third party removes it. Give the pair different reactions and one consolation beat, then retrieve an equivalent functional prop from a previously plausible hidden location and restore the original joint activity.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish two characters sharing one desirable prop and one synchronized activity. Let a third party visibly remove the prop and end that activity. Assign materially different reactions to the pair: one shows frustration while the other receives or offers one brief consolation gesture. Reveal that the second character had an already motivated hidden recovery location, retrieve an equivalent functional prop without theft or unexplained appearance, then restore the original shared activity and hold the partnership payoff. The reusable mechanism is shared possession, external loss, asymmetric reaction, consolation, motivated hidden recovery and restored joint use—not the source dogs, breeds, bed, smartphone, woman, paw pose, exact timing, creator identity, watermark or model branding.

invariants.rule: Show two characters jointly using one desirable prop before it is removed.
invariants.purpose: Makes both possession and relationship stakes legible.
invariants.ablation_failure: A prop held by only one character weakens the shared-loss premise.

invariants.rule: Use one visible third-party action to remove the prop and stop the shared activity.
invariants.purpose: Provides an attributable interruption without ambiguity.
invariants.ablation_failure: An off-screen disappearance cannot support the causal beat.

invariants.rule: Give the pair different readable reactions and exactly one consolation gesture.
invariants.purpose: Turns the loss into a relationship change rather than a simple object gag.
invariants.ablation_failure: Identical reactions or repeated comforting flatten role contrast.

invariants.rule: Recover an equivalent functional prop from a previously plausible hidden location controlled by the partner.
invariants.purpose: Makes the reversal earned and attributable.
invariants.ablation_failure: A prop appearing from nowhere becomes arbitrary magic.

invariants.rule: Return both characters to the original joint activity and hold the restored relationship.
invariants.purpose: Closes the prop and social arcs together.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending at discovery leaves the shared-use payoff incomplete.
